AntiPattern.Bad: Test fails red; agent edits the assertion (`toMatch` → `toContain` → eventual deletion of the assertion) until the test passes, never running `--trace=on`.
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Failure diagnosed by mutation of the test instead of inspection of the actual run (`AX_CLI_TRACE_FOR_FAILURE_DIAGNOSIS`). Real regressions get silenced by progressively weaker assertions; the trace would have shown what actually happened in 30 seconds.
AntiPattern.Good: `npx playwright test --trace=on path/to/failing.spec.ts`; `npx playwright show-trace test-results/.../trace.zip`; identify whether the failure is in the component (fix component) or in the test's contract (fix test, with the new contract documented).
